title: The Stu/dio prepares to share student-led production at MDEV
body:
An Illinois news feature announced The Stu/dio’s planned panel at MDEV 2025 in Madison, Wisconsin. The story highlights Sepehr Vaez Afshar, Sarvin Eshaghi, and Robbie Sieczkowski and the studio’s approach to student-led game production.

Photo: University of Illinois School of Information Sciences, accompanying the original story.

image.alt: The Stu/dio team: Sepehr Vaez Afshar, Sarvin Eshaghi, Dan Cermak, and Robbie Sieczkowski
